title: Say Boses Antis na Bagyo
intro: Sakey a pigura ed desierto so inmalagey pian tawagen so sakey a makapanyarin bansa ya ompawil ed katuaan. Kabkabat iray totoo lapud mararakep iran bilding tan agnaparaan a biskeg da. Balet binulag ira na inkamapaatagey da, tan ag ira labay ya ondengel. Diad kaunoran, sinmabi ed sikara so makapasinagem a dusa, ya akaliktar lambengat na melag a grupo na saray mananisia.
clues: Nibaki ak ed saray makapanyarin totoon manaayam ed saray maawang a dalin tan kabkabat ira ed pakayari ra.
Sinmabi ray totook kayari na sananey a baleg a bansan aderal.
Walaan ira na mararakep iran istruktura tan angipaalagey ira na ataragey iran tori.
Tinawag ko ran mangigalang ed Saksakey a Dios, balet ag da labay ya ikaindan iray talintaoy diriyos da.
Sinmabid sikara so maruksan dusa, tan saramay mananisia labat a kaibak so inliktar to.
Siak so imbaki ed saray makapanyarin totoon tatawagen ya Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
